family.schneider-at-desktops.description: PC2640 and EuroAT: two compact Schneider designs with an 80286 processor.
family.schneider-at-desktops.history: PC2640 introduced a Schneider-designed AT in 1987 while the brand still marketed Amstrad computers. EuroAT later brought AT-class hardware to the compact Euro format, with integrated hard disk and video. The manuals document different boards, chips and ROM layouts; sharing a brand and processor does not make them the same machine. The consulted sources do not establish a direct commercial succession between them.
